title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:

Bitcoin closed north of eighty-one grand, up nearly two percent on the day. That's solid ground-holding in a Fear regime—we're sitting at 43 on the Greed Index, so this wasn't euphoria-driven.

Daily range held tight. We're in a consolidation pocket, which matters: the hashrate stayed robust at 987 exahash, meaning miners aren't panicking despite margin pressure. That's your real signal.
